summary: Latest blog posts. Only with 3 or more published posts.
rules: Hide the block when the blog has fewer than 3 posts.

`titleAlign` is `default` (as in the theme), `left` or `center`: write `default` unless the preset needs a side; a stored `left` under a centred theme is the most common mixed page (`title-align-mixed`).

presets.name: latest-posts-3
presets.use: Three latest posts with dates and an «all posts» button: a carousel of 3, so phones show 2 and a peek instead of a lone third card.
presets.evidence: synthesized: blog shelves are almost absent from the sample (one store runs one, as a carousel)
